data.one_liner: A ListView with sticky headers and an iOS-like clickable sidebar.
data.what_it_does: Provides a ListView widget that includes sticky headers and an interactive sidebar, similar to the iOS contact list. It supports right-to-left languages, custom overlays, and configurable sidebar items.
use_when: You need an alphabetical index sidebar for a long list of items
You want sticky headers within a Flutter ListView
avoid_when: You only need a standard lazy-loaded list without alphabetic indexing
You require custom layout structures completely unrelated to grouped lists
strengths: Easy to set up and customize headers, sidebar, and overlays
Includes haptic feedback features for the scrollbar
weaknesses: Limited to alphabetical or categorized grouped list structures
